about: EmberEngine's own character progression (the user, 2026-10-17). gain = what each level adds: hp atk mag def dex. Level 1 stays Engine2's (content/engine2/class-stats.json). classes = the Engine2 classes the hero plays as (the first one's gains are the old ones; promotions keep the hero's gains). Enemies: each class's own gains times (the party's new gains / its old gains), stat by stat (engine/world/Progression.cpp).
